# Junior Software Engineer, Routing — Indianapolis, IN (hybrid), full-time

You will join the Routing team that builds the Lanes API.
Responsibilities: build and maintain Lanes API endpoints; write SQL against our PostgreSQL route data; write automated tests; work with the dispatch product team.
Required: Python; SQL; REST APIs; Git; experience deploying services on Kubernetes.
Preferred: Go; experience with geospatial data.
